advisories.title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unhandled error on excessive content-encodings
advisories.reason: Not in what customers install from this package. undici reaches this repository only through the Pi host packages we develop and test against (devDependencies @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, which pins undici 8.10.2 exactly in every release through 1.4.0, and openai via @earendil-works/pi-ai); `npm ls undici --omit=dev` is empty and the published dependencies are @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and minisearch. At runtime the customer's undici is their own Pi host's, so the fix (8.12.2+) has to land upstream in pi-coding-agent; overriding the host's exact pin here would only change our test tree. Re-review when pi-coding-agent ships a patched undici.
